name: adwhispr-competitor-ads
description: See your competitors' live ads and what works for them: who is verified to be running ads in your space right now, the Facebook and Instagram ads they have live today shown inline, the ones that have run the longest, their TikTok ads and top TikTok posts, side-by-side brand comparisons, a full competitive brief with a PDF, and real Google keyword data for any market. Use when the user asks who their competitors are, what ads a brand runs, wants winning ad examples for a niche, wants to compare brands, or needs keyword research. Ads are pulled live from the Meta Ad Library and TikTok's public ad library and ranked by how long they have been running, because a brand only keeps paying for an ad that works. Honest by design: ad libraries publish no click rates, conversions or return on ad spend, so this never invents them. Research only: no ad account needed, nothing is launched or changed. Free sign-in to AdWhispr, no API keys, no hooks, data flows only to AdWhispr's own API.
